record.narrative: Among the counted names, 11 ran at least 50 percent above the prior close, and five of them kept at least half of the peak gain at the close; none of them gave the entire move back. The two covered 50 percent movers with the highest peaks were XHG, with fresh news found in our sources: a proposed U.S. AI business expansion alongside a planned reduction of mainland China operations, and VCIG, with fresh news found in our sources: the launch of an AI token platform. After the close, MTEN added 83 percent. 6 of the 12 names the desk covers had fresh news in our sources.

lines.text: Locafy reported in a 6-K at 09:29 ET on October 6, 2026 a definitive agreement to acquire Map Labs' assets and customer base for up to $3.0M in cash ($2.0M upfront and up to $1.0M tied to performance), and the company stated an expected contribution of about $2.0M in ARR and about $900,000 in 2026 EBIT. The desk reads it as a priced acquisition with stated revenue and earnings contributions; the deal is subject to closing conditions, and no closing date is on file.

VCI Global announced the launch of its VGAIN Compute AI Token Platform, presented as an expansion into AI infrastructure and LLM services, with the earliest timed report at 15:50 ET on October 6, 2026. The desk reads it as a new AI platform launch during an unusually high-volume session, with no operating, customer, revenue or deal-value figures in our sources.

XChange TEC announced at 08:30 ET on October 6, 2026 a proposed U.S. AI business expansion with planned investment of $5 million to $10 million, paired with a gradual reduction of its mainland China operations. The desk reads it as a plan and strategic initiative alongside a planned operational cutback, not a completed transaction; no company SEC filing on funding, timetable or financial effect is on file.

The company reported in a foreign private issuer report at 16:30 ET on October 6, 2026 that it completed its acquisition of 100% of the Target Company for $15.0M, indirectly acquiring Shanghai Shangyun Yingfei and Shanghai Minwen. The desk reads it as a material, company-specific completed transaction; sources outside SEC filings were not located, and the acquired businesses' financial contribution is not on file.

Baiya filed first-half fiscal 2026 results at 12:28 ET on September 29, 2026, with a net loss of $2.37M against $4.71M in the comparative period and a loss per share of $(0.54) against $(96.15), while secondary coverage reported sales of $756,805. The desk reads the sharply narrower per-share loss as a fresh company result that can draw attention, while the filing also reports ongoing losses and flags possible significant dilution from future financing.

Not a fresh catalyst: the latest item in our sources is the SEC declaring effective, on September 16, 2026, an F-3 tied to shares potentially issuable under the company's equity purchase facility. The desk reads it as legal resale eligibility for shares from that financing facility; our sources show no sales under the registration.

Not a fresh catalyst: the latest company item in our sources is an August 2026 Nasdaq noncompliance notice over the delayed June 30 Form 10-Q, reported in an 8-K at 17:15 ET on August 21, 2026, which came after a one-for-12 reverse split aimed at minimum bid compliance. The desk reads it as a listing-compliance matter rather than an operating catalyst, set against unusually elevated relative volume in the session, with no news trigger or buyer identified.

Not a fresh catalyst: secondary coverage at 08:35 ET on October 1, 2026 reported that Nuburu unveiled Site Dome and submitted its first proposal to an aerospace-defense customer, with no primary company release in our sources, and a recent SEC filing disclosed a side letter changing warrant valuation and registration terms for certain holders. The desk reads the proposal as a commercial-development item, a proposal rather than an order or contract, with no value or customer named.

The research reached no conclusion on a catalyst: the latest SEC-filed update in our sources is the August 13, 2026 second-quarter results and business update, which included clinical-program updates and an expectation of initial CB-011 dose-expansion data in H2 2026. The desk treats it as possible background whose link to the price action is not established, and sources outside SEC filings were not located.

Kairos reported in an 8-K at 07:30 ET on October 6, 2026 positive, statistically significant interim efficacy data from its ongoing Phase 2 trial of ENV-105 with apalutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, and secondary coverage cited 17.7-month median progression-free survival against 2 months. The desk notes the interim update came on the same date as the session's price increase and elevated relative volume; sample size, follow-up and full statistics are not on file.
Research is not on file for NEPH at this checkpoint.

Not a fresh catalyst: the latest item in our sources is Trevi's August 6, 2026 update reporting that it started its first Phase 3 IPF-related chronic-cough trial and a Phase 2b RCC trial in the second quarter, with a second Phase 3 IPF trial expected to begin in the second half of 2026. The desk reads it as progress for Haduvio across those studies, with no later company event in our sources.
